teaser: One version of you keeps the same seat at the counter for years. Another keeps rearranging the furniture at two in the morning because the room feels wrong. You are a 5, the number built on change and appetite for the new, and an ISFJ, the type built to notice what needs tending and tend it without being asked. Most 5s scatter. This one keeps track of who needs what, even while packing a bag. The pairing sits oddly: a hunger for change that still shows up, on time, for whoever is counting on it.
